name: Michlol Finance Ltd
summary: Michlol Finance Ltd, through its subsidiaries, engages in financing and management of construction projects in Israel and internationally. It offers finance to real estate developers, and medium and small business corporations, such as real estate, industry, technology and services. The company also provides loans primarily backed by residential real estate to private customers. The company was incorporated in 2017 and is based in Bnei Brak, Israel.
